hooks.text: 针对机器人、变种人与荒漠劫匪的弱点，把队员能力组合成战术连携
hooks.excerpt: Robots, mutants, desert raiders: almost all enemies have something up their sleeve. So do your characters: some abilities are most effective in combination with others. Find your opponents' weaknesses, humiliate them on the battlefield, and never ponder the moral implications of your actions!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 职业与人格交叉决定角色技能，同为佣兵也会因反英雄或传教士性格而不同
hooks.excerpt: Combine class and personality types to give each of your characters a unique set of abilities. A Preacher Mercenary and an Antihero Mercenary will behave quite differently.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Twitch观众可直接替队伍决定事件、下一目的地与能力升级
hooks.excerpt: Connect the game to your Twitch account so that your viewers can influence the gameplay! The Twitch Integration feature will enable your chat to make crucial decisions during events, as well as choose your next destination or ability upgrade.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
